# ROBORAB

> ROBORAB deploys AI agents in business processes: fitness CRM, tax agent, construction accounting, booking CRM, SEO and GEO. Start free, subscription from $20 per month.

ROBORAB deploys AI agents into B2B business processes. Plans: Explorer (free), Mentor ($20 per month, or $18 per month billed yearly), Integrator (custom price: replacing an employee or a whole function).

## Products
- Fitness CRM: clients, memberships, schedules, trainer payouts
- Tax agent: group-of-companies taxes, actuals from 1C, forecasts and scenarios
- Construction accounting: sites, materials and costs
- Booking CRM: hotel booking requests in one window
- SEO and GEO: setup, analytics, admin panels
